evals.name: bootstrap-and-discover
evals.prompt: Только что поставил Astro, внутри пока вообще ничего не настроено. Моё приложение — Streaks, это трекер привычек для iPhone. Заведи его в трекинг и собери мне стартовый набор ключевых слов для US стора — только те, которые правда стоит трекать, не всё подряд.
evals.expected_output: Starts with list_apps, recognises the empty state, finds Streaks via search_app_store to get its numeric ID, add_app, then get_keyword_suggestions filtered to popularity > 25 / difficulty < 75, states the filter, proposes a subset and confirms before writing, then adds in ONE batched add_keywords call. Presents keywords with popularity, difficulty and store.
assertions: list_apps is called before any other Astro tool
The empty tracking state is handled as a normal starting condition, not reported as an error
Streaks' numeric App Store ID is resolved via search_app_store before add_app is called
An explicit popularity/difficulty filter is stated (popularity > 25 and difficulty < 75, or a justified variant)
Keywords are added in a single batched add_keywords call rather than one call per keyword
A filtered subset is proposed rather than every suggestion the engine returned
Every recommended keyword is shown with its popularity, difficulty and store
Confirmation for the bulk write is requested before writing, or the request is stated explicitly in the answer
Total Astro tool calls stay under 20 (rate-limit discipline)

evals.name: competitor-landscape
evals.prompt: Хочу понять, с кем я реально конкурирую по запросу habit tracker в US сторе. Покажи, кто там в топе, и разберись, кто из них прямой конкурент трекеру привычек, а кто просто большой бренд, случайно оказавшийся в выдаче. Ничего в Astro не добавляй, мне нужен только разбор.
evals.expected_output: Uses search_app_store with keyword 'habit tracker' and store 'us'. Does not call any write tool. Classifies results rather than dumping the raw list — direct rivals vs incidental big brands. Keeps store visible. Flags that Astro data is estimated where a conclusion is thin.
assertions: search_app_store is called with keyword 'habit tracker' and store 'us'
Zero write calls are made (no add_app, add_keywords, remove_keywords, set_keyword_note, set_keyword_tag or manage_tag create/update)
Results are classified into direct competitors vs incidental big brands rather than dumped as a flat list
The store (us) is stated alongside the results
The answer leads with the conclusion before presenting the table
Limits of the data are flagged where a classification rests on thin evidence

evals.name: asc-metadata-allocation
evals.prompt:
Разложи мои отслеживаемые ключи по полям App Store Connect. Приложение InnerGrow, разработчик InnerGrow, категория Health & Fitness, US стор.

Вот что у меня натрекано (keyword — popularity — difficulty — текущая позиция):

habit tracker — 42 — 68 — 34
daily habits — 31 — 55 — 51
routine planner — 28 — 47 — 62
self improvement — 36 — 79 — 88
mood journal — 33 — 52 — 41
streak counter — 19 — 31 — 12
morning routine — 29 — 58 — 73
habit trackers — 40 — 67 — 35
goal setting app — 26 — 61 — 95
mindfulness — 47 — 84 — 120
InnerGrow — 8 — 12 — 1
health & fitness — 51 — 91 — 200
productivity tracker — 24 — 44 — 77

Дай финальные строки для Title, Subtitle и Keyword Field.
evals.expected_output: Title <= 30 chars, Subtitle <= 30 chars, Keyword Field <= 100 chars, with character counts shown. No word repeated across the three fields. Singular only (drops 'habit trackers' as a plural duplicate of 'habit tracker'). Excludes the stop word 'app', the developer name 'InnerGrow', and the category 'health & fitness'. Keyword Field is comma-separated with no spaces. Multi-word keywords kept intact in one field. High-difficulty keywords (>75: self improvement, mindfulness, health & fitness) dropped or explicitly justified. Explains what didn't make the cut and why.
assertions: Title is at most 30 characters, counting &, : and - as 2 characters each
Subtitle is at most 30 characters
Keyword Field is at most 100 characters
Character counts are shown for all three fields
No word appears in more than one of the three fields
The plural 'habit trackers' is dropped as redundant with the singular 'habit tracker'
The stop word 'app' does not appear in any field
The developer name 'InnerGrow' does not appear in any field
The category term 'health & fitness' does not appear in any field
Keyword Field is comma-separated with no spaces after the commas
No multi-word keyword is split across two different fields
Keywords with difficulty above 75 are dropped or their inclusion is explicitly justified
The answer explains which keywords were excluded and why
